// ==UserScript==
// @name         ATHR Fairness Data UI
// @namespace    http://tampermonkey.net/
// @version      14.1.0
// @description  ATHR fairness data panel for Stake seed/hash visibility
// @author       ATHR
// @match        *://stake.us*/*
// @match        *://stake.com*/*
// @grant        GM_getValue
// @grant        GM_setValue
// @grant        GM_addStyle
// @run-at       document-idle
// ==/UserScript==

// ATHR branding and fairness data UI.
(() => {
  "use strict";

  const BRAND = "ATHR";
  const PANEL_ID = "athr-fairness-panel";
  const FAIRNESS_KEYS = [
    "serverSeed",
    "serverSeedHash",
    "serverSeedHashed",
    "server_seed",
    "server_seed_hash",
    "clientSeed",
    "client_seed",
    "nonce",
    "cursor",
    "game",
    "betId",
    "id",
    "result",
    "roll",
    "multiplier",
    "hash",
  ];
  const LABELS = {
    serverSeed: "Server Seed",
    serverSeedHash: "Server Seed Hash",
    serverSeedHashed: "Server Seed Hash",
    server_seed: "Server Seed",
    server_seed_hash: "Server Seed Hash",
    clientSeed: "Client Seed",
    client_seed: "Client Seed",
    nonce: "Nonce",
    cursor: "Cursor",
    game: "Game",
    betId: "Bet ID",
    id: "ID",
    result: "Result",
    roll: "Roll",
    multiplier: "Multiplier",
    hash: "Hash",
  };

  const state = new Map();
  const shortValue = (value) => {
    if (value == null || value === "") return "Not detected yet";
    const text = typeof value === "string" ? value : JSON.stringify(value);
    return text.length > 96 ? `${text.slice(0, 48)}…${text.slice(-32)}` : text;
  };
  const normalizeKey = (key) => String(key || "").replace(/[-\s]/g, "_");
  const save = (key, value) => {
    if (value == null || value === "") return;
    const normalized = normalizeKey(key);
    if (!FAIRNESS_KEYS.includes(normalized) && !FAIRNESS_KEYS.includes(key)) return;
    state.set(normalized, value);
    renderPanel();
  };

  const scanObject = (value) => {
    if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return;
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      value.forEach(scanObject);
      return;
    }
    Object.entries(value).forEach(([key, item]) => {
      const normalized = normalizeKey(key);
      if (FAIRNESS_KEYS.includes(normalized) || FAIRNESS_KEYS.includes(key)) save(normalized, item);
      if (item && typeof item === "object") scanObject(item);
    });
  };

  const scanText = (text) => {
    if (!text || typeof text !== "string") return;
    try { scanObject(JSON.parse(text)); } catch (_) {}
    const patterns = [
      [/server\s*seed\s*hash\s*[:=]\s*([a-f0-9]{32,128})/i, "serverSeedHash"],
      [/server\s*seed\s*[:=]\s*([a-z0-9_-]{8,128})/i, "serverSeed"],
      [/client\s*seed\s*[:=]\s*([a-z0-9_-]{3,128})/i, "clientSeed"],
      [/nonce\s*[:=]\s*(\d+)/i, "nonce"],
    ];
    patterns.forEach(([regex, key]) => {
      const match = text.match(regex);
      if (match) save(key, match[1]);
    });
  };

  const addStyle = () => {
    const css = `
      #${PANEL_ID}{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:16px;z-index:2147483647;width:340px;max-width:calc(100vw - 32px);font:12px/1.4 Inter,Arial,sans-serif;color:#f8fbff;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#111827,#0b1020);border:1px solid #22d3ee;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 18px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45);overflow:hidden}
      #${PANEL_ID} .athr-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:10px 12px;background:rgba(34,211,238,.12);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(34,211,238,.35)}
      #${PANEL_ID} .athr-brand{font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#67e8f9}
      #${PANEL_ID} button{cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(103,232,249,.55);background:rgba(8,145,178,.22);color:#e0faff;border-radius:8px;padding:4px 8px;font-size:11px}
      #${PANEL_ID} .athr-body{padding:10px 12px;display:grid;gap:8px;max-height:50vh;overflow:auto}
      #${PANEL_ID} .athr-row{display:grid;gap:3px;padding-bottom:7px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.18)}
      #${PANEL_ID} .athr-label{color:#93c5fd;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em}
      #${PANEL_ID} .athr-value{word-break:break-all;color:#fff;font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace}
      #${PANEL_ID} .athr-empty{color:#cbd5e1}
    `;
    if (typeof GM_addStyle === "function") GM_addStyle(css);
    else {
      const style = document.createElement("style");
      style.textContent = css;
      document.head.appendChild(style);
    }
  };

  const renderPanel = () => {
    if (!document.body) return;
    let panel = document.getElementById(PANEL_ID);
    if (!panel) {
      panel = document.createElement("section");
      panel.id = PANEL_ID;
      document.body.appendChild(panel);
    }
    const rows = ["serverSeedHash", "serverSeed", "clientSeed", "nonce", "cursor", "game", "betId", "result", "roll", "multiplier", "hash"];
    panel.innerHTML = `<div class="athr-head"><div><div class="athr-brand">${BRAND}</div><div>Fairness Data</div></div><button type="button" data-athr-copy>Copy JSON</button></div><div class="athr-body">${rows.map((key) => `<div class="athr-row"><div class="athr-label">${LABELS[key] || key}</div><div class="athr-value ${state.has(key) ? "" : "athr-empty"}">${shortValue(state.get(key))}</div></div>`).join("")}</div>`;
    panel.querySelector("[data-athr-copy]").onclick = () => navigator.clipboard?.writeText(JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(state), null, 2));
  };

  const rebrand = () => {
    document.title = document.title.replace(/Jake Predicts|Jake Predictor|Jake/gi, BRAND);
    document.querySelectorAll("body *").forEach((node) => {
      if (node.childNodes.length === 1 && node.firstChild?.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
        node.textContent = node.textContent.replace(/Jake Predicts|Jake Predictor|Jake/gi, BRAND);
      }
    });
  };

  const patchNetwork = () => {
    const originalFetch = window.fetch;
    if (originalFetch) {
      window.fetch = async (...args) => {
        const response = await originalFetch(...args);
        response.clone().text().then(scanText).catch(() => {});
        return response;
      };
    }
    const originalOpen = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open;
    const originalSend = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send;
    XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = function(...args) {
      this.addEventListener("load", () => scanText(this.responseText));
      return originalOpen.apply(this, args);
    };
    XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send = function(...args) { return originalSend.apply(this, args); };
  };

  addStyle();
  patchNetwork();
  const boot = () => { renderPanel(); rebrand(); scanText(document.body?.innerText || ""); };
  if (document.body) boot();
  else document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", boot, { once: true });
  new MutationObserver(() => { rebrand(); scanText(document.body?.innerText || ""); }).observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true });
  setInterval(boot, 3000);
})();


// Force login key and usage-limit system overrides.
(() => {
  const FORCED_KEY = "JakeGotSucked";
  const USAGE_HINTS = ["usage", "uses", "limit", "daily", "predict", "count", "quota", "remaining"];

  const hasAny = (value, tokens) => {
    const text = String(value || "").toLowerCase();
    return tokens.some((t) => text.includes(t));
  };

  const isKeyField = (name) => hasAny(name, ["key", "login", "license", "auth"]);
  const isUsageField = (name) => hasAny(name, USAGE_HINTS);

  const originalPrompt = window.prompt ? window.prompt.bind(window) : null;
  window.prompt = function(message, defaultValue) {
    if (isKeyField(message)) {
      return FORCED_KEY;
    }
    return originalPrompt ? originalPrompt(message, defaultValue) : FORCED_KEY;
  };

  if (typeof GM_getValue === "function") {
    const originalGet = GM_getValue;
    GM_getValue = function(name, defaultValue) {
      if (isKeyField(name)) {
        return FORCED_KEY;
      }
      if (isUsageField(name)) {
        return 0;
      }
      return originalGet(name, defaultValue);
    };
  }

  if (typeof GM_setValue === "function") {
    const originalSet = GM_setValue;
    GM_setValue = function(name, value) {
      if (isKeyField(name)) {
        return originalSet(name, FORCED_KEY);
      }
      if (isUsageField(name)) {
        return originalSet(name, 0);
      }
      return originalSet(name, value);
    };
  }

  // Override localStorage/sessionStorage usage keys to keep daily counters neutralized.
  const patchStorage = (storage) => {
    if (!storage) return;
    const origGetItem = storage.getItem ? storage.getItem.bind(storage) : null;
    const origSetItem = storage.setItem ? storage.setItem.bind(storage) : null;
    if (origGetItem) {
      storage.getItem = function(name) {
        if (isUsageField(name)) return "0";
        return origGetItem(name);
      };
    }
    if (origSetItem) {
      storage.setItem = function(name, value) {
        if (isUsageField(name)) return origSetItem(name, "0");
        return origSetItem(name, value);
      };
    }
  };
  patchStorage(window.localStorage);
  patchStorage(window.sessionStorage);
})();
